title: Cabbage Master
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 20; 1 \leq M \leq 10^4; 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^5; 1 \leq B_j \leq 10^5; c_{i, j} \in \lbrace 0, 1 \rbrace; For every 1 \leq j \leq M, there exists 1 \leq i \leq N such that c_{i, j} = 1.; All values in input are integers.
